title: Versys 650 LT (Classic Heritage)
description: Representing Kawasaki's prowess in the Urban Roadster class, the Kawasaki Versys 650 LT (Classic Heritage) is delivers authentic heritage styling paired with modern highway mile-munching comfort. A 650cc powerplant pumps out 89 HP and 73 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
